note: Real screens of the reference instance for the approval flow and a completed workbook load. Taken by guide/tools/screens.mjs --file APPROVALS.screens.json into guide/public/screens/appr-*.png and wbload-*.png. Screens with "as": "approver" sign in as GUIDE_APPROVER_USERNAME (rita.approver, a Data owner in Graubuenden). The screens are one-off and run in order against instance state APPROVALS.data-changes.md describes: the appr-* screens read the change set 93b863fb-d82b-4faa-b0c7-778377fa448a ('Guide approval example'), which they send back, resubmit and approve (appr-send-back-reason, appr-resubmit and appr-approve act in their 'after' step), so they cannot be taken twice; the second-person rule had to be on for appr-own-approval. The wbload-* screens read the model draft 5ff78a6f-4353-4a3d-8929-47f6bb14b5c7 and the change set 96a3e4df-358c-4461-8c93-1801f0a27842 in the workspace guide-workbook-test; wbload-running and wbload-finished continue in the session of wbload-dialog (run those three in one call). appr-inbox-notice needs the approver's notice unread: opening the review page marks it read.

screens.name: appr-submitted
screens.shows: The submitter's change set 'Guide approval example' right after submitting: banner 'Waiting for approval', submitted by Guide Admin, version 2, the comment, Review and decide and Withdraw request.

screens.name: appr-own-approval
screens.shows: The submitter opens Review and decide on their own request: with the second-person rule on there is no decision panel, only 'A second person must decide this request.' above the changes.

waitFor.text: A second person must decide this request.

expect: A second person must decide this request.

screens.name: appr-home-waiting
screens.shows: Home of Rita Approver (Data owner in Graubünden): 'Waiting for your approval' lists 'Guide approval example', submitted by Guide Admin, with Review.

screens.name: appr-inbox-notice
screens.shows: The approver's inbox panel behind the bell: the unread notice that a change set waits for approval.

screens.name: appr-decision-panel
screens.shows: The approver's review page of 'Guide approval example': the Decision panel (who submitted, version, the submitter's comment, a Comment field required to send back, Send back, Approve and publish) above the one changed record.

screens.name: appr-send-back-reason
screens.shows: The approver's Decision panel with a reason typed into Comment, before pressing Send back (the comment is required to send back).

screens.shows: The submitter's change set after the approver sent it back: the request is no longer waiting; the banner shows it was sent back with the approver's reason.
expect: Please name the source of the new height before this is published.

screens.name: appr-sent-back-notice
screens.shows: The submitter's inbox panel: the newest unread notice says the request was sent back.

screens.name: appr-resubmit
screens.shows: The submitter presses Submit for publication again after a send back: the dialog (the change set is validated, then waits for someone who may approve it; cannot be edited while it waits) with a new comment typed.

expect: Source added: the height is taken from the national survey.

screens.name: appr-approve

expect: Source added: the height is taken from the national survey.

screens.name: appr-approved-notice
screens.shows: The submitter's inbox panel after the approver approved: the newest notice says the request was approved and published.

screens.name: appr-publication
screens.shows: Publications of Network after the approval: Publication 2 is current, published by Rita Approver; Publication 1 is replaced.

screens.name: appr-activity
screens.shows: Activity of Graubünden after the approval: the submission, send back, resubmission and approval of 'Guide approval example' as entries with who and when.

screens.name: wbload-dialog
screens.shows: 'Load the workbook': the three steps with Guide workbook test chosen as the workspace: install and activate the model (release key, version 1.0.1, name), open a change set, load the rows; button 'Install, activate and load'.
expect: Load Haltestellen_Busbetrieb_Nord.xlsx into a change set

screens.name: wbload-running
screens.shows: The same dialog a moment after pressing 'Install, activate and load': the stages run in turn and the button shows the current one.

screens.name: wbload-finished
screens.shows: The dialog when the load has finished: all three steps done, the load's counts, and 'Open the change set review'.

screens.name: wbload-review
screens.shows: The change set review in the test workspace (opened from 'Open the change set review'): what the load created, as a list of record changes with their counts.

screens.name: wbload-records
screens.shows: The load's change set in the test workspace, in the new application's Haltestellen list: the records the workbook created (the change set is open, not published).
